text:
Anya: quick sync 1 AcmeRetail wants eval-triggered alerts + per-customer quant recs in the Optimize toolkit pilot. Need a tight pilot scope by EOD Fri.
Diego: I can ship batching + cache recs + webhook alerts fast. Quant recs with safe canary need offline profiling.
Rina: offline quant sims + a small canary probe. Estimate 4 weeks for two model families. We can provide confidence scores with each rec.
Omar: infra needs per-customer isolation for eval jobs and rate-limiting. Also a fallback flow to switch traffic to non-quantized replica on regressions.
Maya: Acme wants CSV history and an approval step before any prod changes. Webhooks + manual approve is acceptable for pilot.
Anya: proposed pilot M0: webhooks + eval-alert engine + batching/caching recs + CSV export + manual approve. M1: automated quant recs + canary rollouts + Console UI.
Diego: acceptance metrics to present to Acme: alert latency < 30s post-eval, batch/cache rec shows estimated token savings, canary fallback < 60s, quality delta < 2% for 95% of eval items.
Rina: sample pilot alert rule:
`eval_alert: model:redwood-34b metric:exact_match threshold:0.87 window:500 action:webhook_notify,trigger_fallback`
Anya: action items: Diego -> webhook schema PR; Rina -> profiling plan + cost; Omar -> SLOs/rate-limits; Maya -> collect Acme eval set by Wed. I'll draft pilot acceptance doc and ping for review.
